method: Rendered 8.5x11 PNG previews of the interior PDF and inspected each page.
style_limit: Unpaid procedural line art. Not a licensed illustrator package. Paid image generation remains disabled.

pages.notes: Coloring scene is one festival composition: church with intact steeple cross, two children each holding a lantern, pumpkins, leaves, string lights, welcome table. No letters in the artwork. Faces are simple and intact. Arms are stylized ovals, not broken anatomy. Residual: geometric coloring-book style, not licensed illustration.

Background was drawn without the eight targets. Targets are independent assets; the numbered legend uses the same names as the compositor manifest. Bible, pumpkin, apple, basket, acorn, and leaf are readable. Scarf is a striped band matched by the legend icon. Residual: sparse grounds and simplified lantern icon. Child can complete the hunt from the labeled legend.

Child with lantern stands at the START opening; welcome table is the FINISH under the church. Maze is a garden hedge with one unique path (confirmed on the answer-key page). Instruction is readable without adult decoding. Residual: still a clear maze grid, now with start/finish pictures in the same scene rather than clip-art around a blank box.

One lantern-framed page: labeled kid paraphrase (not Bible wording), four illustrated checkable choices, large lantern drawing area, and prayer ribbon. Checkboxes and drawing space are usable for ages 5-8. Title, labels, and prayer are visible.
